resources.string: One place for the whole household: shopping, chores, meals, appliances, family chat and dates.
You can belong to several families later: your household, your siblings, the extended family.
Turn on what you need now. Everything can be changed later in Settings.
No family yet. Create one to get started.
No modules are on for you in this family.
Saved on this phone only. Connect cloud sync to share with your family.
Join our family \"%1$s\" in SmartFamily with the code %2$s (valid for 48 hours).
Delete \"%1$s\" for every member? This cannot be undone.
Invites and joining work once cloud sync is connected (Settings → Cloud sync).
Request sent. An admin of that family needs to approve you.
The family switch is set by admins. Your own switch can only hide a module for you.
Shared lists, voice, barcode and photo
Fridge, freezer, pantry and expiry dates
Washer, dryer, AC, car: guides and timers
Weekly plan, kashrut and cooking timers
Home tasks, Shabbat prep and kids\' points
Lists by bag, days and weather
Use the colours of your wallpaper (Android 12+)
Turns off every feature that sends data to an outside service
Sign in with the same account on every family phone. On the phone everything is stored encrypted; chat and secrets are also end-to-end encrypted in the cloud, and each family sees only its own data.
Account created. Confirm it from the email Supabase sent, then sign in.
The backup file holds all your families and settings, encrypted with a password you choose (Argon2id + AES-256).
Keep the password safe: without it the file cannot be opened, by anyone.
Replace the data on this phone?
This backup holds %1$d families. It will replace everything on this phone now.
Wrong password, or the file is damaged
Today shows what matters now: what to buy, today\'s events and tasks, and Shabbat times. Tap the family name to switch families; ⋮ on a card changes its size.
Here you manage every family you belong to: members, roles, invites, sharing and features. Owners and admins can invite people and approve requests.
Every feature can be switched off. Admins decide what the family uses, and anyone can hide a feature just for themselves.
Language, theme, privacy, cloud sync and backups. Privacy mode turns off every outside service at once.
Save a list as a template (for example \"Shabbat basics\") and add it in one tap.
Product not found for barcode %1$s. Type its name.
The list is empty. Add the first item above.
Sent to a parent for approval
%1$d items in the cart go to the purchase history. Recurring items come back unticked.
Also add them to the home inventory
Photo of a shelf or groceries
Nothing here yet. Add items, scan a barcode, or finish a shopping trip with \"add to inventory\".
A daily notification for food that expires within 3 days
Photo recognition of products, lists and shelves uses Google Gemini with your own API key. Get a free key at aistudio.google.com (API keys).
FREE: Gemini\'s free tier has daily limits, and Google may use what you send on the free tier to improve its products.
[PAID] option: a billed Gemini key has higher limits and Google does not use the data for training.
Add a Gemini key in Settings → AI services to recognise photos.
Privacy mode is on, so photo recognition is off.
Use the arrows to change the order of modules on the home screen (this phone only).
Type, say, scan or photograph items. Tap an item to edit it, tick it when it is in the cart. \"I\'m at the store\" shows the family that you are shopping; \"Finish shopping\" records what was bought.
What is at home, where it is and when it expires. Set a minimum and the shopping list suggests the item when it runs low.
No chores yet. Add one, or start from the ready-made list.
Pick the chores your home uses. You can edit each one later.
Chores repeat on a schedule and remind the right person. \"Before Shabbat\" chores are timed from candle lighting in your city. Kids\' chores earn points after a parent approves them.
No family dates yet. Add birthdays, anniversaries and yahrzeits.

Scroll up and down through the months. Switch between Hebrew and Gregorian months, and choose which date is primary (⋮ menu). Tap a day for its details and zmanim, long-press to add. Go to any date, including a Hebrew date you type (e.g. \"15 Shevat 5787\"), with the calendar button. Family dates can follow the Hebrew or the Gregorian date every year; events can repeat by the Hebrew date too.
Chores, family dates and events. Held during Shabbat and holidays.
No recipes yet. Add one, import it from a website, photograph a recipe, or ask for ideas.
Could not read a recipe there
Add what is missing to the list
One per line: \"2 cups flour\", \"3 eggs\"
Anything else (who is eating, what you feel like)

Recipes, the week\'s menu and packed meals. Import a recipe from a website (free) or a photo (AI), scale it, and send what is missing to the shopping list. Cooking mode keeps the screen on and finds the timers in each step.
Add each person who takes food: a child to kindergarten or school, a soldier, work.
Place rules (e.g. no nuts, dairy only, no sweets on Sunday)
Same item at most times a week
Add your washing machine, dryer, dishwasher, air conditioner or car to get program advice, error codes, maintenance reminders and live status.
Fill from a photo of the label
No guide yet. Add the manual in one of these ways:
Build it with an AI chat (free)
1. Copy the prompt. 2. Open Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini, paste it and attach the PDF manual. 3. Copy the whole answer and paste it here.
Share the PDF to the chat app
Paste the answer (or any text about the appliance)
Photo of the panel or a manual page (AI)
The answer did not match the guide format
The PDF is larger than 19 MB; use the AI-chat way instead
Ask AI with this machine\'s manual
Add the guide first (Guide tab) so the advice uses this machine\'s programs.
Free developer account at developer.home-connect.com → register an application with OAuth flow \"Device Flow\" → copy its Client ID here.
Open the link and enter the code %1$s
Create a personal access token at account.smartthings.com/tokens with \"devices\" permissions, and paste it here. It stays encrypted on this phone.
No devices found in that account
Remote start is off on the appliance
Tadiran air conditioners use the Tadiran Connect app; there is no open interface, so the guide and reminders work without a live connection.

Each appliance gets a guide built from its manual: programs, buttons, symbols, error codes and maintenance. \"What to run\" picks a program of your own machine for the load. Bosch and Samsung appliances can show live status.
The family chat works once you are signed in to cloud sync (Settings → Cloud sync).
🔒 Encrypted message (the key has not reached this phone yet)
Waiting for a family member\'s phone to share this chat\'s key. Open the chat on another phone.
Compare these numbers in person: if they match on both phones, nobody is in the middle.
The file is larger than 20 MB
Allow the microphone to record voice messages
🔒 Messages are end-to-end encrypted on your phones

Family and private chats, end-to-end encrypted: the server only stores ciphertext. Hold the microphone to record, tap a voice message to transcribe it. Long-press a message to reply, react, edit or delete it for everyone.

Create a trip, pick its type and who is going. The packing list is built for you, and when the trip is within 16 days the free Open-Meteo forecast adds rain or cold-weather items. Everyone ticks items on their own phone.
No trips yet. Plan one and the packing list is ready in a second.
Packing list ready, including the weather forecast
Packing list ready (no forecast yet: it is available up to 16 days ahead)
Delete this trip and its list?
Record expenses and income, mark fixed monthly items, and set a monthly limit per category. Tap a category to change its limit.

Home book: contacts (plumber, electrician, doctor), service and warranty dates, documents. Warranties expiring within 30 days are highlighted. Knowledge box: family how-tos (how to reset the boiler, where the main tap is). Do not store passwords or card numbers here.
Nothing yet. Add the plumber, the electrician or a warranty.
Nothing yet. Write down how things work at home.
Please do not store passwords, ID or card numbers here.
Ask the family: where to go on holiday, what to eat on Shabbat. Everyone votes on their own phone. \"Anonymous\" hides names in the results.

Pick the branches near you (Stores tab). The app downloads their public price files straight from each chain, for free, as required by the Israeli Food Law. Then choose a shopping list: you see every chain side by side, not just the cheapest. ✓ = same barcode, ≈ = closest name match (check it). Prices on the shelf, club deals and promotions may differ.
First pick the branches you shop at.
Prices come from the chains\' public price files and do not include club prices or promotions. Name matches (≈) are a best guess.
Open a chain, find your branch and tick it. Its prices are downloaded once and updated when you tap ⟳.
Shira Market: I could not find a public price file for it, so it is not on the list yet. If you know where it publishes its prices, it can be added.

Share a whole feature (all recipes, the calendar…) or one item (a recipe, a trip, a shopping list, a chat) with another family, read-only or editable. Nothing is shown to them until one of their admins accepts. A shared chat is only visible to the people in it. The family that receives a share sees your family in its family list with only what you shared.
Send it to the other family\'s admin so they can share with you.
All of it, or one item?
Chat link: people from both families can start group and private chats with each other. Messages stay end-to-end encrypted.
Offer sent. It starts once their admin accepts.
The error was saved on this phone only. Copy it and paste it in the chat with whoever builds the app, so it can be fixed.
Fingerprint, face or the phone\'s PIN when the app opens
Hides the app in recent apps and blocks screenshots and screen recording
Bigger buttons and text. Automatic = on for child accounts
Installed version %1$s. New versions are announced when the app opens
Download the new APK and install it over this one. Your data stays.

• Chat now works for family members who joined later
• Instant chat notifications (the text stays encrypted)
• First run: join an existing family with a code or QR
• Features chosen by area
This category is at %1$s%% of its monthly limit
This category reached %1$s%% of its monthly limit
e.g. \"milk and eggs\", \"Tuesday 16:00 dentist for Tzur\", \"clean the AC filter tomorrow\"
No albums yet. Create one and everyone in the family adds photos – encrypted end-to-end.
Photos are added from the album like chat photos and stay encrypted.
Add grandparents, parents and children; link them and the tree draws itself.
The family tree, shared encrypted photo albums, the family phone book and shared gifts. A shared gift splits the cost between whoever joins.

Repairs log with the fixer and warranty, meter readings with a warning on unusual usage (a possible leak), ready-made kits (emergency, leaving home, beach…), and secret notes such as the guest Wi-Fi as a QR code – encrypted with the family chat key.
A picture board the child ticks every morning and evening, and a growth log (height, weight, shoe and clothes size) with a reminder to measure again.
Fixed bills and subscriptions with the monthly total, pocket money per child, savings goals, and shared costs between family members (who owes whom).

Countdown to candle lighting, a preparation timeline scheduled back from it, the Shabbat checklist and meals, quick guest polls, and one-tap holiday packs (shopping list, tasks and checklist) for Pesach, Sukkot, Rosh Hashana, Chanukah, Purim and Shavuot.
Add a reading now and then (a photo of the meter helps); from the second reading you see usage per day.
Nothing broke yet 🙂 Log repairs to remember who fixed what and the warranty.
Guests scan this with the camera to join the Wi-Fi
Encrypted on this phone with the family chat key: only family phones can read it.
Add the guest Wi-Fi (shown as a QR code) or a door code.
Unusual usage: %1$s per day vs an average of %2$s. Worth checking for a leak.
Six months passed – time to measure (and check the shoes) again
Add children to the family (Families → members) to give them a board.
Add the fixed bills (arnona, electricity, kindergarten) and subscriptions to see the monthly total and get reminded.
Set a savings goal – a bike, a family trip – and track it together.
Children in the family get a pocket-money balance here.
Saved without encryption: open the family chat once (signed in) to create the family key, then save again.
One tap prepares everything for the holiday: a shopping list, tasks scheduled back from the date and a checklist. All of it can be edited afterwards.

Everything here is switched off. Turn features on in Settings → Features.
The first four appear in the bar; the rest are under \"More\".
Turn on what your family needs — for everyone (\"Family\") or just for you (\"For me\").
A family admin can turn these on for everyone. You can hide things just for yourself.
Everything is grouped like the app. Turn a feature on or off for the whole family, or only for yourself.
Someone in the family already uses SmartFamily: join with their invite code or QR.
You are the first in the family; invite the others afterwards.
First sign in. Each person has their own account (email); the family is shared.

After a family admin approves you, everything appears here by itself.
